gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Futuristic tiles of Audiowide stand up front, every stroke drawn with no swell at all. Noto Serif Ahom follows, a classic serif whose joins taper gently and whose tall lowercase feels dignified.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-armenian: Authoritative in tone, Noto Serif Armenian is a classic serif with generous counters, set under the tile-like, uniform-stroke Audiowide. Mild contrast meets none.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-balinese: Noto Serif Balinese reads as a text serif with tall lowercase and a moderate stroke contrast, comfortably editorial. And Audiowide, bent like a paperclip, gives that steady text a sharp, techy front door.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Sleek tiles, then refined text. Audiowide leads with joins as slim as a pipe cleaner, and Noto Serif Bengali, a classic serif with lightly sprung contrast, can take a slightly larger size so its trimmed ascenders stay comfortable.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-devanagari: Literary in spirit, Noto Serif Devanagari has a big lowercase and sturdy hairlines beside its stems. And Audiowide, bent from thin steel rod, keeps things futuristic while the serif carries a long read smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-dives-akuru: Tech tiles meet letterpress calm. Audiowide's horizontals match its verticals, while Noto Serif Dives Akuru, a serif with short capitals and tall small letters, would carry a long passage with soft, refined ease.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-dogra: Bookish at heart, Noto Serif Dogra keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. And Audiowide, with no swelling in its bowls, contrasts with that crayon-faint rhythm, so the serif can be sized up a touch.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-ethiopic: Noto Serif Ethiopic forms solid word blocks, a classic serif with modest modulation. Audiowide, with no thick-thin swing at all, feels futuristic and sharp beside its bookish, quietly shaded text.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-georgian: Rope-coiled lowercase, subdued contrast. Audiowide does best with a constant pen-pressure look and futuristic punch, while Noto Serif Georgian, a text serif, is better at authoritative, literary paragraphs.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-gujarati: Audiowide draws diagonals as heavy as its verticals, a futuristic show of tiles. Noto Serif Gujarati, a classic serif, does the opposite, easing its weight softly through oversized, bookish letters.
